_note: Occurrences merge: future expansion orchestration + past SELECT + sort/cap/has_more. Source: app/views/scheduler/occurrences.py:105-208. SEAM: per-binding expansion arrives in Rust as an injected expand_binding closure over jobs occurrences_between + coerce (services cannot depend on jobs) - this file pins the CALL SHAPE and the merge, not the expansion math. SQL captured via str(queryset.query); row shapes verified against contract OCCURRENCE_KEYS.

cap.future_rule: remaining_cap starts 5000; each binding expands with cap=remaining_cap; after each binding remaining_cap = 5000 - len(occurrences) (:130-157); loop breaks early when remaining_cap <= 0 (:133-134)
cap.past_rule: past loop breaks when len(occurrences) >= 5000 WITHOUT setting truncated_at (:178-180) - QUIRK: past-driven overflow is SILENT, has_more stays False and next_window_start stays None
cap.truncation_rule: truncated_at is set ONLY when a binding's expansion reports hit_cap AND remaining_cap hit exactly 0 (:158-160); a window that fills exactly without hit_cap reports has_more False

conjuncts: plus the manager scheduler_bindings.deleted_at IS NULL
future_bindings_filter.expansion_order: scheduler_bindings.created_at DESC (model default ordering - the view adds no order_by; newest binding expands first)
future_bindings_filter.joins: INNER projects (deleted filter) + INNER schedulers (enabled + deleted filters) + INNER workspaces (slug filter); select_related(scheduler) feeds scheduler_name/color without extra queries
future_bindings_filter.sql: SELECT bindings.*, schedulers.* FROM scheduler_bindings INNER JOIN projects ON (bindings.project_id = projects.id) INNER JOIN schedulers ON (bindings.scheduler_id = schedulers.id) INNER JOIN workspaces ON (bindings.workspace_id = workspaces.id) WHERE (bindings.deleted_at IS NULL AND bindings.enabled AND projects.deleted_at IS NULL AND bindings.project_id = :pid AND schedulers.deleted_at IS NULL AND schedulers.is_enabled AND workspaces.slug = :slug) ORDER BY bindings.created_at DESC

future_row.fallbacks: scheduler_color = scheduler.color or '#3b82f6' (:150); tzid = binding.tzid or 'UTC' (:152)
keys: dtstart = occ.isoformat() with +00:00 suffix (NOT Z - plain datetime.isoformat, :151)

has_more_next_window_start.next_window_start: truncated_at.isoformat() or None (:199) - the isoformat of the LAST expanded occurrence of the binding that hit the cap (:159)

past_rows.guard: queried only when window_start < past_end (:166); past_end = min(window_end, now) (:165) so a fully-future window skips the query
quirks: NO scheduler_bindings.deleted_at filter on the past query - runs whose binding (or scheduler) was since soft-deleted are STILL included (the INNER JOIN carries no tombstone predicate)
NO project__deleted_at filter either - only scheduler_binding__project_id equality
past_rows.range: started_at >= window_start AND started_at <= past_end (both INCLUSIVE, :172-173)

sort.note: STRING sort on the dtstart field (:196), not chronological: future rows carry occ.isoformat() and past rows started_at.isoformat(), both +00:00-suffixed in practice, so lexicographic == chronological unless mixed offsets ever appear
sort.rule: occurrences.sort(key=lambda o: o['dtstart']) AFTER interleaving past + future (:196)
